story: Aiko prepares a special snack for her family on a Wednesday morning. She uses a new recipe to cook strawberries. She measures the table and thinks about her age.
title: Aiko's Wednesday Morning
setting: A bright kitchen in the morning.

characters.name: Aiko
characters.look: A young girl with black hair in two small buns.

characters.name: Dan
characters.look: A tall man with short brown hair.

sentences.en: It is a sunny Wednesday a.m.
sentences.zh: 这是一个阳光明媚的星期三上午。
sentences.scene_prompt: Aiko with black hair in two small buns looks out a bright kitchen window on a sunny morning.

sentences.en: The young girl wants to start cooking.
sentences.zh: 这个小女孩想要开始做饭。
sentences.scene_prompt: Aiko with black hair in two small buns stands in a kitchen with a cookbook.

sentences.en: She puts a red strawberry on the table.
sentences.zh: 她把一颗红色的草莓放在桌子上。
sentences.scene_prompt: Aiko with black hair in two small buns places a red strawberry on a wooden table.

sentences.en: The table is one metre long.
sentences.scene_prompt: Aiko with black hair in two small buns holds a measuring tape against a wooden table.

sentences.en: She uses a new recipe today.
sentences.zh: 她今天使用了一个新食谱。
sentences.scene_prompt: Aiko with black hair in two small buns reads a cookbook in the kitchen.

sentences.en: Aiko is sixteen years old now.
sentences.scene_prompt: Aiko with black hair in two small buns smiles happily in the kitchen.

sentences.en: She will be seventeen next December.
sentences.zh: 她明年十二月就十七岁了。
sentences.scene_prompt: Aiko with black hair in two small buns looks at a calendar showing December.

sentences.en: Her family eats together every week.
sentences.zh: 她的家人每周都一起吃饭。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan, a tall man with short brown hair, sits at the table with Aiko.
